strings.subtitle: — Mufuishi wa mifidi —
strings.dnd_unavailable: Kukoka ne kuleka ke biakudimu. Longolola lubaya lwa panshi.
strings.shred_button: F U I S H A
strings.ssd_warning:
Dilongolola! Mu SSD, mbila wa kufunda patoka kewakanyisha kufuisha mu mhamba wa TRIM.
Ndonga eyi idi ya HDD.
strings.confirm_text:
Mufidi "{name}" ukufundibwa patoka ne kufuibwa.

Kulonda?
strings.confirm_lnk_text:
Aku shortcut (.lnk). Shortcut wayo yavula ikapangibwa.

File wa kupanga ukashala pano.

Kutwala?
strings.drive_remote_warning:
Aku network drive (\\server\share).
Kufunda pa sector ke na kupanga — server we na snapshot, deduplication to CoW.

Kutwala?
strings.drive_removable_warning:
Aku removable drive (USB / HDD wa kunze).
Controller we na kubika block wa kala.

Kutwala?
strings.report_limits:
• NTFS mishiku ya malu yambulwa (ADS) ke musalayi wa kufunda.
• Mukanda wa USN ke wakudimu.
• Bifwatulu bwa mudidi ne bikwata bwenge
  (OneDrive ne bionso) ke bikutshikisa.
strings.step_delete: Kufuisha kupita ku mbemba ya mvunvu
strings.status_full: Malu onso afundibwe patoka ne zeru. Kudilula kena kumueneka — bingidi bwa kubala bikamona zeru bua.
strings.status_fast: Mutwe, mukila ne 4 MB mishiku ifundibwe patoka. Bimwe ke bitSHIKA, mbwenu mu mhamba wa mpunga, kudilula kwonso ne bingidi bwa balombi ke kumueneka. Mu mikanda ya nkuku, longolola mudimu WA MBUMBU.
strings.status_empty: Mufidi wadi tshibenda, kufunda patoka ke kwakudimu. Wafuibwe.
strings.error_permission: Ke na kukoka kufika pa file. We na kubulwa mu program mukuabo. Kudisha ne kumeka.
strings.error_not_found: File ke na kumona. We na kupangibwa kale.
strings.error_is_symlink: Aku symbolic link. Link ke na kupangibwa — file wa kupanga ukashala pano.
strings.error_reparse: Aku placeholder file (OneDrive to mukuabo). Bidibwa bye mu cloud, ke mu diski — ke na kya kupanga pano.
strings.error_not_file: Aku ke file (dosie to mukuabo). Koka file.
strings.error_hardlinks: File we na hard link mikuabo ({n} yoso). Hard link ke na mwandamisha — mashina oso apalana. Uka kupanga mu njila wa lelu, bidibwa bikafundibwa ne kukatwa pa 32 bytes, pano bishale bikakoka kufika mu link mikuabo. Kupanga link yoso kumpala.
strings.error_compressed:
File ufundibwa, usandjibwa to sparse. Kufunda ne zéro ke na kupanga bidibwa bya kala mwanda NTFS ubika mukuabo.

Kupesha attribut: kanda ku dikasa dya dikumi → Propriétés → Avancé → kupesha 'Compress' ne/to 'Encrypt'. Panyima, pandisha SHREDDER.
strings.queue_stopping: ⏹ Kusoka panyima pa file wa lelu...
strings.queue_confirm_text:
Bifile {count} bikapangibwa.
Bunene buoso: {size}.

Tala mukanda wa bifile kumpala wa kutwala.
Kupanga oku kukoka kubwezwa.
strings.queue_clear_confirm_text:
Kupesha bifile {count} bionso mu mudimu?

Bifile mwine BIKEKALABWAPO — mukanda wavula.
strings.hardlink_text:
File "{name}" we na hard link mikuabo ({nlink} yoso).

Bidibwa bikapangibwa pa mashina oso.
Pano bishale (32 bytes) bikashala panshi ya mashina makuabo mu dosie.

Ona mwanda wa kupanga bishale bino ku lubanza.
strings.hardlink_apply_all: Kubaka pa hard link yoso mu mudimu
